혹시나 몰라서 전체를..

;------------------------------------------------------------
; Script Name: Server's Fish Poison Trainer
; Author: Server
; Version: 1.02
; Client Tested with: 4.0.0p
; EUO version tested with: 1.40
; Shard OSI / FS: OSI
; Revision Date: 9/29/03
; Public Release: 9/24/03
; Purpose: Poisons fish steak with kegs in
; backpack and cures with regs.
;------------------------------------------------------------
;1:Open your status bar if poisoning skill is
; below 80.
;2:Put poison kegs you wish to use in your
; backpack.
;3:Makesure you have exactly 10 fish steaks
; in your backpack no more no less.
;4:Have atleast 1 bottle in your backpack.
;5:Hit Play
;------------------------------------------------------------
;Setup:
;set the extra time for lag delay (only affects delay befor poisoning again)
;20 = 1 secound
set %Extra 20
;------------------------------------------------------------
initevents
gosub Setup
chooseskill Pois
set %Gained 0
Mainloop:
set %Skill #Skill
gosub AmountCheck
gosub FillBottle
gosub Split
gosub PoisonFish
gosub CheckPoisoned
gosub DragBack
gosub GainCheck
goto Mainloop:
;--------Subs---------------------------------------------
sub Setup
event macro 8 7
wait 1s
contPos 745 488
wait 1s
return

sub AmountCheck
set %Action Counting_Fish_Steaks
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
finditem HND C
;see if there is enough
if #findstack < 10
{
gosub HaltScript
}
if #findstack > 11
{
gosub HaltScript
}
Return

sub FillBottle
set %Action Filling_Bottle
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
finditem QMJ C
if #findkind = -1
{
gosub ScriptHalt
}
set #LobjectID #FindID
event macro 17 0
wait 30
Return

sub Split
set %Action Splitting_Fish_Steaks
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
finditem HND C
event drag #FindID
wait 1s
msg 1 $
wait 10
click 787 552 p
wait 1s
Return

sub PoisonFish
set %Action Poisoning_Fish_Steaks
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
event macro 13 30
wait 1s
finditem AVF C
if #Findkind = -1
{
gosub HaltScript
}
set #LtargetID #FindID
event macro 22
wait 1s
PoisonFish:
finditem HND C
If #findstack <> 1
{
ignoreitem #FindID
goto PoisonFish
}
set #LtargetID #FindID
event macro 22
set %waitTimer 20 + %extra
wait %WaitTimer
Return

sub CheckPoisoned
set %Action Checking_If_Poisoned
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
if C in #CharStatus
{
event macro 15 10
target
event macro 23 0
wait 1s
gosub CheckPoisoned
}
if #hits < ( #MaxHits - 10 )
{
event macro 15 28
target
event macro 23 0
wait 1s
}
Return

sub DragBack
set %Action Dragging_Fish_Steak_Back_To_Pile
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
finditem HND C
event drag #findid
wait 1s
click 400 265 p
wait 1s
ignoreitem reset
Return

sub GainCheck
set %Action Checking_For_Gain
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Current Action: %Action
if %Skill = #Skill
{
Return
}
set %Gained %Gained + 1
Return

sub haltscript
setUOTitle Poisoning: #Skill Gained: %Gained Action: Script Halted
halt
;------------------------------------------------------------
